title: Custom right-click menu for WINE system tray icon is mis-positioned when using a fractional scale factor
line: Right-clicking a Wine or other XEmbed tray icon on Wayland opens its menu at the icon again when screens use different or fractional scales.
explanation: The system tray tells xembedsniproxy where the icon is in Xwayland coordinates. It scaled the position by the panel window's device pixel ratio, and with several screens added the screen's position, but KWin scales the whole Xwayland coordinate space by one Xwayland scale (the largest screen scale), so the click went to the wrong place and the app's menu didn't open or opened elsewhere. The change reads KWin's Xwayland scale from kwinrc (as open MR !7409 does) and multiplies the position by it everywhere.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: map XEmbed icon clicks with the Xwayland scale

Clicks on XEmbed tray icons were scaled by the panel's pixel ratio and
the screen's position, but Xwayland uses KWin's own scale everywhere, so
the click missed the icon. Read that scale from kwinrc and apply it.

BUG: 491582

media.caption: Master, panel screen at 100% plus a 200% screen: right-clicking the XEmbed icon does nothing (click sent to X 896,770 instead of 1792,1540).
With the fix: same setup, the icon's menu opens at the icon.
Open MR !7409 with the panel screen to the right of the 200% screen: still no menu (click sent to X 3072 instead of 4352).
With the fix: same layout, the menu opens at the icon.
